name: CTOS Digital Bhd
summary: CTOS Digital Berhad functions as an investment holding company, delivering specialized credit reporting and digital software solutions across Malaysia and Thailand. The company provides a range of credit information services, including the sale of reports, continuous monitoring, and trade referencing capabilities. It also licenses its software products and offers comprehensive installation and ongoing maintenance support to a diverse clientele, encompassing major corporations, other businesses, and individual consumers. Furthermore, CTOS offers in-depth commercial credit analyses and large-scale commercial data services. Its advanced digital offerings include electronic Know-Your-Customer (eKYC) solutions, tools for application processing and decision-making, fraud prevention mechanisms, and portfolio review services. Beyond these core services, the company engages in software development, outsourcing, and training. It also manages debt collection and database administration, alongside a broad spectrum of information and advisory services such as business intelligence, credit bureau operations, market list generation, market research, industry studies, and related consultancy. CTOS caters to a wide array of clients, specifically financial institutions, telecommunications providers, insurance companies, e-commerce platforms, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), and individual customers. Founded in 1990, CTOS Digital Berhad maintains its headquarters in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
